posts.text: 🎙 🇷🇺 Statement by Permanent Representative of the Russian Federation to the International Organizations in Vienna Mikhail Ulyanov at the Seventh Session of the UN Conference on the Establishment of the Middle East Zone Free of Nuclear Weapons and Other Weapons of Mass Destruction 📍 New York, 16 November 2026 💬 We are compelled to note that, since our last meeting , the international security and nuclear non-proliferation landscape has not undergone any significant improvement . The escalation in the Middle East has not subsided. Following the unlawful and unprovoked US-Israeli aggression against Iran’s nuclear facilities, which were under IAEA safeguards , in June 2025, the United States and Israel embarked on a new and unprecedented escalation in February-April this year. The war is still ongoing and has affected a number of other countries in the region. Unfortunately, despite the efforts being made, a sustainable peaceful settlement has yet to be achieved. 👉 The threat of a resumption of armed hostilities remains. <…> ❌ The difficult situation prevailing today in the field of nuclear non-proliferation was also reflected in the fact that the Eleventh Review Conference of the Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons (NPT), held here in New York this spring, concluded without the adoption of a final document. *** Now, more than ever, there is a pressing need for collective political and diplomatic efforts aimed at de-escalating tensions and maintaining dialogue across the entire range of issues related to regional security. 📄 A sufficient number of relevant initiatives are already on the table, covering either the entire Middle East or individual parts of the region. One such initiative is Russia’s Concept of Collective Security in the Persian Gulf Region , which was most recently updated in 2026. *** For seven years now, the UN Conference on the Establishment of a Middle East Zone Free of Nuclear Weapons and Other Weapons of Mass Destruction has been building on the substantial results achieved in its earlier work. In addition to the aforementioned consensus rule, we have a substantive political declaration; representatives of the IAEA and the OPCW Secretariats regularly participate in the forum’s proceedings; meetings of the intersessional Working Committee are held, and, more recently, have also been hosted by countries of the region; and the fifth session of the Conference, in 2024, was held in a review format for the first time. ☝️ All this provides a solid foundation for further progress . Тяжелый украинский гексакоптер для эвакуации раненых «Gurzuf Defence» - уничтожен Относительно недавно украинские формирования провели первую реальную эвакуацию раненого с фронта посредством тяжелого беспилотника. Однако после этого фактов успешного проведения подобной операции больше не было. И вот одна из причин почему: потому что своим пиаром они привлекли внимание к подобным дронам На ваших кадрах момент как оператор российского FPV-дрона обнаружил в лесном массиве как раз-таки этот самый эвакуационный дрон, который уже находился на земле. Ну и не надо рассказывать, что в итоге произошло с этим дроном, после того как его обнаружил наш оператор. Такие дроны громоздкие, из-за чего эвакуацию проводить очень сложно, потому что внимание к ним высокое. Но сам факт того, что подобных изделий у ВСУ больше, остается очевидным. И в России пока с альтернативами не густо, и в первую очередь это связано из-за проблем со связью. @arx_spn
